critical_code_review_comments: geo.py BHILAI_CLUSTERS table has two entries with the same centroid (Smriti Nagar 21.1938,81.3509 and Bhilai Nagar 21.1937,81.3509) — `min(...)` ordering is therefore not deterministic and the resolved cluster name flickers between the two for the exact same coordinate. Pick one canonical name (suggest 'Smriti Nagar' since the UX spec mentions it) or de-duplicate the centroid.
ConsumerHeader.tsx still trends past ~423 lines; consider extracting LocationChip + SearchSuggestions sub-components (carryover from iter-23 review).

Recommend adding explicit data-testid='search-overlay-backdrop' for harness clarity — currently the backdrop is unaddressable except via 'outside the panel' coordinate math.
